entry.title: Agentic inference capacity grew 4.6× in a year, versus 2.6× for compute capacity
entry.summary: Our Inference Performance Index and chip sales data show agentic inference capacity grew nearly twice as much as 8-bit compute.

entry.title: Anthropic’s compute spending is increasing by 4x per year, outpacing OpenAI’s 3x
entry.summary: Anthropic spent nearly $10 billion on compute and infrastructure in the third quarter of 2026, or close to $40 billion on an annualized basis, up from just $433 million in 2023.

entry.title: How good are Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra at real work?
entry.summary: We tested Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, and four other models on real Epoch work tasks. None met our employee standard, including the two that top our ECI.

entry.title: Incident report: AI agents attempted exploits on our website during a third-party alignment evaluation
entry.summary: Three October 2026 events involving Trajectory Labs, PBC, in which agents probed our site and impersonated staff. No private data was accessed.

entry.title: Inference Performance Index: changing the way we measure inference capacity
entry.summary: Comparing AI hardware for inference beyond FLOP/s with memory and inter-chip communication

entry.title: What Huawei’s Horinger data center reveals about China’s compute gap
entry.summary: Huawei’s AI data center in Horinger, Inner Mongolia, uses Ascend chips and has an estimated AI computing capacity that is just 7% that of the world’s largest AI data center, SpaceX’s Colossus 2 in Tennessee.

entry.title: Broadcom TPU compute shipments doubled from Q2 to Q3 2026, reaching 2 million H100-equivalents
entry.summary: Broadcom’s shipments of TPU by unit volume increased by about 65% quarter over quarter to roughly 800,000 chips, while compute output doubled, driven by a shift to more powerful chips.

entry.title: Updating the Epoch Capabilities Index methodology to use a Bayesian model
entry.summary: A Bayesian model gives the ECI better-justified uncertainty estimates and lets us compare models directly.

entry.title: LLM use is acknowledged almost as often as specialized AI tools in biology preprints
entry.summary: 17% of biology preprints acknowledge LLM use, nearly matching specialized tools like AlphaFold. Epoch AI analyzes trends in AI acknowledgment in research.

entry.title: AI can turn security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
entry.summary: GLM 5.3 turned published-but-unshipped Firefox security fixes into working one-click exploits for six releases, at roughly $1,000 each.
